nodes.title: AGENT GUIDE - MiniMax H3 socket workflow
widgets_values:
AGENT GUIDE - MiniMax H3 two-phase socket workflow

1) INPUT MANAGER (outside the subgraph): choose image/video/audio counts and files. Paired audio selects Video reference 1/2/3; do not upload the same video again for its audio.

2) SUBGRAPH: all VHS_LoadVideoPath loaders, shared FPS, frame cap, resize and per-slot switches are already inside. Do not add a second reference-video path or connect a separate reference_bundle.

3) PROMPT ORDER: use <Picture N>, <Video N>, and <Audio N> in presentation order. Paired audio is numbered by video order, then standalone audio. When Generate audio without reference is ON, remove copy/reference-audio wording; H3 generates a new soundtrack.

4) MODES: one_phase ON bypasses latent upscale and TaoMate and runs PDD 8-Step at final resolution. one_phase OFF runs Phase 1 PDD 8-Step at phase1_scale, then latent upscale and Phase 2 TaoMate 3-Step. Default Phase-2 ManualSigmas: 0.7000, 0.4667, 0.2333, 0.0000.

5) OUTPUT SETTINGS: final_megapixels plus aspect_ratio determine the final canvas, up to 2.0 MP when native_area_cap is OFF. Set FPS and frames to match the source/reference video. Keep the same seed when comparing modes.

6) OUTPUTS: the subgraph exposes Rendered video and Selected audio. Rendered video is connected to SaveVideo (video/minimax_h3, MP4). The audio socket is available for an audio-aware downstream saver.

7) CHECK BEFORE QUEUE: confirm the custom node is loaded, counts match active files, prompt tags match counts, paired-audio sources point to enabled videos with audio, and model/LoRA branches are unchanged during benchmarks.

8) MULTIFRAME REFERENCE: set Multiframe reference count in Reference Manager from 0–5. The manager exposes dedicated Guide image 1–5 slots and their times. Prompt Picture numbering uses ordinary image references first, then active guides. For example, with 0 ordinary images and 1 guide, Guide 1 is `<Picture 1>`; with 2 ordinary images, Guide 1 is `<Picture 3>`. Active slots are consecutive from Guide 1 through the selected count. Each guide is sent to Qwen Vision and also anchored at its time. Times convert to frame indices at a fixed 24 fps. Each active guide is applied in both Phase 1 and Phase 2; count 0 disables the full guide chain.

widgets_values:
UNET + text encoder: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 (or any repack — int8 convrot builds work too). Pair the Ref2VA PDD file with a ref2va UNET, FL2VA with fl2va.

PDD Acc file goes in models/pdd_acc/ — either the original alibaba-pai/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs release or the pre-converted ComfyUI copy (aptech0081/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs-ComfyUI). Both load.

Optional: wire reference images into ref_image_0... for identity-locked r2v.

nodes.title: Recipe (do not change)
widgets_values:
PHASE 1 uses the native MiniMax H3 PDD Acc model branch: euler, 8 PDD steps, CFG 1.0, SigmaShift 12/3.

PHASE 2 is intentionally a separate branch from the shifted base model: TaoMate 3-step LoRA, euler, ManualSigmas [0.7000, 0.4667, 0.2333, 0.0000]. The first sigma is the 0.70 denoise setting. The TaoMate LoRA is NOT stacked on the PDD-patched model.

No cache nodes (T8/EasyCache). Character LoRAs can be added only after this baseline is verified.

nodes.title: PHASE 2 - MiniMax H3 + prompt guides + images and standalone audio
PHASE 2 — TaoMate 3-step refine at selected target resolution
Split AV — keep Phase-1 audio untouched
PHASE 1 -> neural H3 latent upscale to selected final target
H3 FRAMES - duration to 17k+5 at 24 FPS
PHASE 1 SCALE — minimum 0.2 MP / optional lock

widgets_values:
VIDEO DIMENSION CONTROLS
WIDTH/HEIGHT feed the selected generation path. PHASE 1 SCALE controls Phase 1 relative to Phase 2, with a minimum area of 0.2 MP. PHASE 1 ONLY 0.2 MP ON locks Phase 1 to the minimum 0.2 MP size; OFF uses PHASE 1 SCALE but clamps it to at least 0.2 MP. ONE PHASE PDD ON bypasses latent upscale + TaoMate and sends the final target resolution directly through PDD. ONE PHASE PDD OFF keeps the PDD -> latent upscale -> TaoMate two-phase path.

MiniMax H3 two-phase workflow. The external Reference Input Manager stores only counts, filenames, and paired-audio source selections; all loaders, source-aspect resize nodes, and per-slot switches live inside the subgraph and connect directly to native H3 reference sockets.
